for (const remove of [false, true]) {
  const value = JSON.parse("[1,2]", function(this: any, key, item) {
    if (key === "0") Object.defineProperty(this, "1", {value: 5, writable: false, configurable: false});
    return key === "1" && remove ? undefined : item;
  });
  console.log(value);
}
console.log(JSON.parse('{"a":1,"b":2}', function(this: any, key, item) {
  if (key === "a") Object.freeze(this);
  return key === "b" ? undefined : item;
}));
console.log(JSON.parse("[1,2]", function(this: any, key, item) {
  if (key === "0") {this.length = 1; Object.defineProperty(this, "length", {writable: false});}
  return key === "1" ? 7 : item;
}));
console.log(JSON.parse("[1,2]", function(this: any, key, item) {
  if (key === "0") {delete this[1]; Object.preventExtensions(this);}
  return key === "1" ? 7 : item;
}));
